omissions: NodeTitle, NodeDescription, NodeFooter (upstream Node card sub-parts; our title is a WorkflowNode header prop and description/footer slots are plain children)
Edge.Temporary and Edge.Animated (upstream edge renderer components; edge geometry is the ReactFlow layer's job)
Upstream Connection as a ReactFlow connectionLineComponent (pending-connection drag geometry is the renderer's job)
Upstream Canvas ReactFlow wrapper itself (pre-configured pan/zoom/selection/delete/fitView behaviors bound to the AI SDK data model)
divergences: Renderer-neutral presentational anatomy: upstream Canvas wraps ReactFlow directly, while @xyflow/react never enters this package; a host owns the ReactFlow renderer
WorkflowEdge and WorkflowConnection are legend/inline representations (from -> to, pending-connection validity) rather than ReactFlow edge/connection-line renderers
WorkflowNodeStatus is a smithers addition (shared StatusPill) with no upstream equivalent
WorkflowMinimap is a labelled seam frame with no upstream component; upstream parks ReactFlow's MiniMap as a Canvas child
WorkflowToolbar is plain canvas chrome; upstream Toolbar wraps ReactFlow's per-node NodeToolbar
WorkflowControls renders buttons only from caller-provided callbacks; upstream Controls binds the ReactFlow viewport API directly
WorkflowCanvas is role=group, not role=application: the base layer ships no application-mode keyboard contract

WorkflowNode renders with role=option when the renderer passes a selection state, so aria-selected is supported by the role and survives into the accessibility tree (on a generic div it is stripped); nodes without a selection model stay generic
WorkflowEdge status is not color-only: a per-status-class shape glyph plus an sr-only status label accompany the colored signifier
WorkflowControls and WorkflowToolbar implement the ARIA toolbar keyboard contract: roving tabindex with Arrow/Home/End navigation that never lands on disabled items and ignores modifier-key chords
WorkflowConnection exposes its validity state via sr-only text instead of aria-hidden
Lane CSS fragment composed into smithersUiCss, which every canvas component injects
